items.t: Clayton, Cloverdale: 72 houses sold at a median of $1,295,000, with the middle half between $1,213,500 and $1,411,250. The median house took 24 days to sell and closed at 97.2% of list.

169 townhomes sold in Clayton, Cloverdale at a median of $760,000 (middle half $699,900 to $823,000). A typical townhome in Clayton, Cloverdale spent 20 days on the market and closed at 97.6% of the asking price.
In Clayton, Cloverdale, condos sold at a median of $464,400 across 72 sales, and the middle half closed between $413,750 and $550,500. The median condo sat 26 days and sold for 97.2% of list.

blocks.text: 3 Duplexes also sold in Clayton, Cloverdale, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
